# Capsule CRM | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| One sentence | Emphasis on simple contacts, distribution pipelines and small and medium-sized enterprises for project delivery. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competition Boundaries | Complex forecasting, help desk and enterprise-level object models are limited; local transactions/taxes in Hong Kong are not core and need to be integrated with accounting or ERP. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Complex forecasting, help desk and enterprise-level object models are limited; local transactions/taxes in Hong Kong are not core and need to be integrated by accounting or ERP. |
